impacto_motivo: Overlined lips is used in a complimentary way to describe a fuller, well-defined lip effect.

significado: Artificial lashes applied to add volume and length to the eyes.
exemplo_correto: I put on thin falsies just at the outer corners to look more natural.
exemplos_incorretos: She wore falsies under her dress for the costume party.
He wears falsies since he lost his real teeth.
I bought falsies for my nails, they just stick on.
significados_incorretos: Padding or inserts worn in a bra to enlarge the bustline.
Artificial teeth or dentures used to replace lost natural teeth.
Artificial press-on nails applied over the natural ones.
impacto_motivo: Falsies are seen as a positive resource to enhance the eyes in a practical and reversible way.

significado: When makeup moves out of place, runs or wears off, usually from sweat, crying or rain. It became a meme when it happens in public.
exemplo_correto: I cried so hard at the movie that my makeup got totally smudged.
exemplos_incorretos: The paint on the wall got smudged after the rain.
The writing in my notebook got all smudged when I spilled water on it.
The photo came out smudged because I shook the camera when taking it.
significados_incorretos: Paint smeared across a freshly painted wall.
Writing that is hard to read because the ink spread on wet paper.
Blur effect in photos taken with a shaky camera.
impacto_motivo: Smudged describes an unwanted makeup failure, associated with frustration or embarrassment.

significado: Having no makeup on the face, with natural skin on display.
exemplo_correto: Today I decided to go bare-faced, just sunscreen.
exemplos_incorretos: He told a bare-faced lie to my face about what happened.
The mannequin in the window was bare-faced, with no features painted on.
After the exfoliating scrub, my skin felt bare-faced and squeaky clean.
significados_incorretos: Brazen or shameless, done openly with no attempt to hide it.
Doll or display mannequin with a blank, unpainted face.
Result of a facial exfoliant that leaves skin with a deep-clean feeling.
impacto_motivo: Bare-faced is used positively to value natural beauty without makeup.

significado: Technique of sculpting the face with darker products in shadow areas and lighter ones in highlight areas, creating depth and defining features.
exemplo_correto: I did some very light contouring just to slim my face in photos.
exemplos_incorretos: The surveyor marked the contouring of the hill on the map before construction.
The seamstress traced the contouring of the pattern before cutting the fabric.
The illustrator did the contouring of the character's face before coloring.
significados_incorretos: Line that outlines the shape of terrain in a construction or mapping project.
Outline used by seamstresses to mark a pattern before cutting the fabric.
Artistic drawing technique used to emphasize the edges of a face in illustrations.
impacto_motivo: Contouring is valued as a technique that helps sculpt and define facial features.
